regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative leadership: Coal is the sole eligible trend leader with a mean-revert hurst tag and thin breadth (0.5). The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (it mean-reverts), and cross-sectional momentum has rank-IC ~0, so this detector is a focus/de-risking lens only — NOT predictive. Track record shows direction accuracy 0.337 on 98 calls; default conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935) for a CONFIRMED handoff from Coal — currently ineligible (gate not passed) with breadth 0.0, so it is not yet a leader. Not actionable until that observable state change occurs.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only confirmed eligible trend leader (rank 1, score 0.992, eligible=true) with one-narrative concentration. The trend gate is technically passing for it, but since gate_helps=false on this market, the eligibility is attention, not alpha. Durability_bar is middling (0.52) and hurst_tag is mean-revert, so the leadership is real but fragile. Lean is a direction expressed by the confirmed leader, fully aware the detector has no forward return edge here.
evidence: gate_helps=false on this market (validated edge absent)
theses.dissent: Coal's mean-revert hurst tag plus thin breadth (0.5) suggests this leadership may already be fading; the trend gate's eligibility is unvalidated on A-shares and whipsaws on mean-reverting tapes. The one-narrative concentration (absorption 0.34) leaves no rotation fuel if this single theme stalls.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS gives up all gains relative to CSI 300 over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks rank 3 with strong durability_bar (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), BUT crowding_z 1.83 flags it as crowded. Guardrails explicitly forbid fading the leader on crowding, but Banks is NOT the leader — Coal is. For a non-leader with this crowding texture, the detector's only validated edge (down-sizing on crowding) argues for caution rather than chase. An 'avoid' lean reflects the crowding caution applied to a crowded non-leader.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest durability (0.83) and full breadth — structurally the healthiest trend on the board. Crowding in China financials can persist for long periods under policy support (SOE reform), so an 'avoid' could miss extended continuation.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days despite the crowding flag
